blocks.title: Mabuhay, {name}! 🌊
blocks.subtitle: Welcome to the historic jewel of Lamon Bay — home to the white sandbars of Cagbalete Island, cascading waterfalls, and world-class Buntal weaving craftsmanship.

blocks.title: Why Visit Mauban, Quezon?
blocks.subtitle: The historic coastal sanctuary of southern Luzon
blocks.body: Nestled along the Pacific coast of Lamon Bay, Mauban boasts powdery white sandbars with expansive tidal ripples, centuries-old ancestral trees, cascading mountain pools, and a proud cultural identity shaped by Gat Uban and palm artisans.

blocks.title: Mauban Port ↔ Cagbalete Boats
blocks.body:
Standard boat departures from Mauban Port: 07:00 AM, 10:00 AM, 01:00 PM, and 04:00 PM.
Island Port Arrival: Sabang Port (during high tide) or Mappit Port (during low tide).
Environmental Fee: {fee_regular} per visitor. Children aged 7 and below, senior citizens aged 60 and above, and visitors with special needs pay {fee_discounted}. Pay at the {fee_office}.
Boat fare is separate. You arrange and pay it directly with the boat operator; the Tourism Office does not collect it.
Tourism Office, 2nd Floor, Mauban Municipal Hall

items.title: Cagbalete Island Boat Guide
items.short_text: Passenger pumpboats depart daily from Mauban Port to Sabang & Daungan. The Environmental Fee is paid at the {fee_office}. The boat fare is separate and is paid to the boat operator.

items.title: Maubanin Buntal Festival (May)
items.short_text: A week-long celebration showcasing giant woven Buntal hats, street dancing, and the historical legacy of Gat Uban.

items.title: Environmental Fee
items.short_text: All tourists register at the {fee_office}. Receipts serve as your official entry pass to the island sanctuaries.

items.title: Solid Waste & Leave No Trace Policy
items.short_text: Help keep Cagbalete and Mauban pristine by avoiding single-use plastics and taking your trash back to mainland disposal points.

items.title: Upcoming: Fiesta de Mauban & Buntal Festival
items.short_text: Celebrate the feast of San Buenaventura with colorful Buntal weaving and boat regatta.

items.title: Clean Coast & Eco-Tourism Policy
items.short_text: Please dispose of trash responsibly and support local community bangkeros and weavers.
